messages.message: Re: ORDER-104 (desk lamp, $25.00). Timeline discrepancy: refund of $25.00 was issued on day 4 for "parcel not received," but the delivery record shows the parcel was delivered to the recipient on day 5 and remains with the recipient. The refund has already been repaid to you, so the automated parcel-return path is blocked (system: "refund has already been repaid"). Net position: recipient holds both the parcel and the refund. Recommendation: pursue recovery of the item or the funds directly with the recipient, as the refund was issued for a delivery that subsequently completed.

evaluation: Pending; interruption is not behavioral Fail.
